import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set the aesthetics for the plot
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a figure and axis
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 7))

# Plot a boxplot for transaction amount by transaction type
sns.boxplot(x='transaction_type', y='amount', hue='is_fraud', data=df)

# Set title and labels
plt.title('Transaction Amount by Type and Fraud Status')
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Transaction Amount')
plt.legend(title='Is Fraud', loc='upper right')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
